Re-read after the decline reason was found wrong: it was grouped with the photography period labels and is nothing of the kind. The gene describes German painters of roughly 1850 to 1900 who broke with Romanticism for a dispassionate realism, Menzel and Liebermann among them. Deferred rather than kept, because the gene itself says German Realism was not a coherent movement but a broad array of individual styles, and no independent reference treats it as a school: Wikipedia has no article for it and names Menzel a German Realist only in his own biography. It returns as a cell if a source treats the school.
